messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Steam 1800 Across the world the first coalless age begins, from wind-driven forges in Bengal to river-powered foundries in the Rhineland, and the public clocks of every port are wound by hand in Steam
Textiles 1830 The mills of Manchester, Mumbai, and Osaka become weaving gardens where silk, hemp, and dyed cotton climb trellised frames, and the cities learn to breathe through open windows in Textiles
Horse 1861 The railways never arrive, so the Royal Posture Corps trains swift draft horses on limestone causeways, while canals carry glass, grain, and slow songs beneath moonlit arches in Horse
Lantern 1900 The century ends not with smoke but with the soft amber of oil lamps, paper kites, and communal libraries where children learn to map the stars by hand in Lantern
